svg.title: Ryan — Codex NightView, mint edition
svg.desc: 25,993,510,522 account-reported Codex tokens across 98 returned dates, 2026-07-25 to 2026-10-31. A 13-week isometric calendar adapted from GitHub Profile 3D Contrib NightView. Heights use the original logarithmic mapping with tokens measured in millions. Missing dates are unknown, not zero. All-device coverage is not established.
